tone.target: dark dry indie rock rhythm with tight low-end bite

tone.summary: A dry, aggressive indie rock tone achieved with a slight OD boost into a UK 45/UK 50 style amp, emphasizing midrange bite for palm-muted riffs.
corrections: Aim for indie rock, not pop-punk
